source_commit_note: Validation identity is a documentation follow-up; implementation/test hashes below are the committed sources.

entry.child: real child via fixed ConPTY; initial 160 numbered lines, one spontaneous append, m/3/r/q commands

rules.wheel: accumulate 120-unit detents; step = QStyleHints::wheelScrollLines line count. 0 disables wheel scrolling and is NOT a page step; >0 uses that many lines; negative values are not treated as an invented page marker. Fixed Qt 6.10 Windows maps native WHEEL_PAGESCROLL to its default 3 ("unimplemented in Qt"), so page-per-step is flattened to 3 and is a recorded known difference vs the R1 Win32 direct SPI path. App-internal recoverable override covers 0/3/half detent; host global setting is untouched.
rules.home_end: Ctrl+Shift+Home -> oldest retained row; Ctrl+Shift+End -> live bottom
rules.new_output: paused reading page keeps the same source anchor; new output does not replace it
rules.ordinary_input: any ordinary terminal key returns to the live bottom before encoding
rules.eviction_ed3_ris: invalid anchor clamps to the earliest retained row and stays paused until an explicit bottom action
rules.isolation: each widget owns its HistoryViewport; two sessions do not share viewport state
rules.half_detent: two 60-unit events produce one 120-unit detent; the first half must not scroll

screenshots.note: Same offscreen widget, same controlled child session; not physical presentation or DPI evidence.

remaining_decision.item: old six-stage --resize native-grid vs retained-source addressing
remaining_decision.required: a concrete product contract proposal (retained-source CUP interpretation or known-difference listing for the native grid) plus a decision on the old literal assertion entry; original intermediate native state remains unobserved

limitations: Single offscreen display, fixed 80x24/60x24, short ASCII lines and bounded history; no scrollbar drag, PageUp/PageDown history mapping, paste-return, selection/copy/Find UI during history reading, physical presentation/DPI, full reflow, Unicode history or performance.
Wheel/reading-anchor behavior derives from the R1 Win32 product contract, not a new WindTerm runtime oracle; original WindTerm wheel/PageUp behavior remains unknown.

Qt 6.10 Windows flattens the native page-scroll setting to 3 lines (unimplemented page marker), so this Qt path does not preserve the R1 WHEEL_PAGESCROLL page step; this is a recorded known difference, not an equivalence claim. Zero disables scrolling and is not a page step.
History pages are bounded source-anchor projections; unsupported retained atoms fall back to a clipped physical history page and do not claim complete mapping coverage.
No production policy change to the six-stage native-grid question; #27/#29/#30/#7 remain open.

qt_wheel_source.windows_theme_fact: DWORD(-1) WHEEL_PAGESCROLL is kept as default 3 and marked unimplemented; other values including 0 pass through
qt_wheel_source.style_hints_fact: wheelScrollLines() is a line-count getter; the internal setter only overrides positive values and defines no negative page marker
